Fact.Name: Line 21 of Schedule 2
Fact.Description: Other taxes, including self-employment Line 21 of schedule 2 for line 23 of form 1040. Line 4 SE tax from Schedule SE (26 U.S.C. 1401). #82 (2026 Schedule 2 draft): line 11 Additional Medicare Tax on SE income (Form 8959 line 18) and line 17b Additional Medicare tax on Medicare wages (Form 8959 line 12); line 21 = line 15 + line 20. #83: line 6 Net investment income tax (Form 8960 line 17), in line 15 = lines 4 through 11 and 14. #116: line 5, the 10% additional tax on a Form 1099-R code 1 early distribution (schedule2 /schedule2Line5).

Fact.Description: Total tax as reported on line 24 of Form 1040.

Fact.Name: Form 1099 withholding
Fact.Description: Federal income tax withheld from wages, as reported on line 25b of Form 1040. #86: includes Form 1099-DIV box 4 (Form 1040 instr. (2025) https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1040gi.pdf p. 39, Line 25b: "If you received a 2025 Form 1099 showing federal income tax withheld on dividends ... include the amount withheld in the total on line 25b. This should be shown in box 4 of Form 1099").

Fact.Description: Form 1040 line 25c (other forms). #82: Additional Medicare Tax withholding from Form 8959 line 24; f8959 (2026 draft) line 24 "Also include this amount with federal income tax withholding on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 25c"; i8959 (2026 draft) p.4, Line 24. No other line 25c source is supported.

Fact.Description: Whether the TP has qualified for any refundable credit This fact drives whether a summarytable is displayed in the credit summary page. If you change that table, you must also change this fact.
